inferred_requirements.title: Atomic Financial Ledger Transaction
inferred_requirements.description: The system must execute financial ledger entries as an atomic transaction ensuring all-or-nothing persistence across multi-legged entries.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly requested in prompt: 'Implement an atomic financial ledger transaction'.

inferred_requirements.title: Debit and Credit Balance Invariance
inferred_requirements.description: The system must enforce double-entry bookkeeping balance invariance where the sum of debits must equal the sum of credits for every committed transaction.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly requested in prompt: 'debit/credit balance invariance'.

inferred_requirements.title: Idempotency Check
inferred_requirements.description: The system must perform an idempotency check prior to transaction processing to prevent duplicate execution of identical transaction requests.

inferred_requirements.title: Idempotency Key Persistence and Uniqueness Constraint
inferred_requirements.description: The system must store idempotency keys alongside request hashes with a strict database unique constraint.
inferred_requirements.justification:
Why 1 (Context/Risk): Without persistent uniqueness checks, concurrent duplicate requests can bypass application-layer memory checks.
Why 2 (Technical Mechanism): A unique database constraint on the idempotency key column guarantees database-level race condition prevention.
Why 3 (Mandatory Invariant): The system must never process duplicate transaction requests under concurrent load.

inferred_requirements.title: ACID Database Isolation for Balance Updates
inferred_requirements.description: The system must execute balance reads and writes using serializable or repeatable read isolation levels to prevent lost updates.
inferred_requirements.justification:
Why 1 (Context/Risk): Concurrent transactions against the same account balances can introduce race conditions leading to negative balances or corrupt invariants.
Why 2 (Technical Mechanism): Utilizing row-level locking or strict database transaction isolation prevents interleaved updates.
Why 3 (Mandatory Invariant): Account balance invariants and double-entry balancing must hold true under high-concurrency conditions.

inferred_requirements.title: Idempotency Key Expiration Window
inferred_requirements.description: The retention period or time-to-live (TTL) for idempotency keys is unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: The prompt does not specify how long idempotency keys must be retained before expiration.

inferred_requirements.title: Ledger Storage Technology and Schema
inferred_requirements.description: The specific database engine, storage provider, and schema design for the ledger are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: No specific database technology or schema layout was provided in the prompt.
